Two platforms, zero compromises

Your players don't care which phone they own — and with us, neither do you. Every project ships on both stores, tuned to each platform's conventions.

Android

Native-feeling apps and games for the world's biggest mobile platform, tested across the devices your audience actually uses — not just the flagship.

  • Google Play release & review handling
  • Material You design language
  • Kotlin native or Flutter cross-platform

iOS

App Store–ready builds that respect Apple's Human Interface Guidelines and make the most of the hardware — from haptics to widgets to Game Center.

  • App Store submission & review handling
  • Swift native or Flutter cross-platform
  • iPhone & iPad layouts from day one

How a project runs

No black boxes. You see builds early, play prototypes on your own phone, and always know what ships next.

01

Discover

We dig into your idea, audience and competitors, then define the smallest version worth launching — and what success looks like.

02

Design

Wireframes become a clickable prototype in days. You tap through real flows and we fix the awkward parts before any code exists.

03

Build

Art, animation and engineering in weekly slices, with a fresh test build on your phone every Friday. No surprises at the end.

04

Launch & grow

We handle store submission, listing assets and review replies — then keep shipping events, levels and features after release.

A small studio with a big soft spot for play

BumStudio is an independent team of designers, artists and engineers who believe the best mobile products feel like toys: instantly understandable, satisfying to touch, and hard to put down.

We stay deliberately small. The people you meet on the first call are the people who design your screens, draw your characters and write your code — for startups launching their first app and for brands that need a game with real staying power.
